items.title: Pfizer hikes full-year outlook on new product growth, taps company veteran as new CFO
items.summary: Pfizer announced that Cecile Guegan, who has held various leadership roles at the company over the last 20 years, stepped in as CFO this month.
items.title_zh: 辉瑞因新产品增长上调全年指引，并任命公司老将出任新任 CFO
items.summary_zh: 辉瑞宣布，过去 20 年间在公司担任多个领导职务的塞西尔·盖冈本月出任首席财务官。

items.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
items.summary: The BLS reported job openings at 7.52 million, up 333,000 from August and well above the Dow Jones consensus outlook for 7.15 million
items.title_zh: 职位空缺 9 月大幅增加，为就业报告前的劳动力市场正面信号
items.summary_zh: 美国劳工统计局公布职位空缺为 752 万，较 8 月增加 33.3 万，远高于道琼斯共识预期的 715 万

items.title: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto
items.summary: Binance has replenished 98% of $6.34 billion in affected assets, according to a security report the crypto exchange issued Tuesday.
items.title_zh: 币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 称黑客利用虚假面试与 AI 工具盗走 63 亿美元加密资产
items.summary_zh: 据这家加密交易所周二发布的安全报告，币安已补足 63.4 亿美元受影响资产中的 98%。
